clips.title: The story
paras: In Menethil Harbor, Harlo Barnaby bears the wounds of Dun Modr's fall. The dwarven refugee escaped the Dark Iron assault and warns travelers of the tragedy in the northern marshes.

Harlo Barnaby fled Dun Modr when Dark Iron dwarves struck the northern stronghold without warning. In the chaos, a stray axe hit him square in the back. The blow knocked him unconscious, yet he survived the trek across the marshland. Harlo awoke bandaged in Menethil Harbor, alive but marked by his wounds and memories of the massacre. He cannot return to Dun Modr, so he urges Alliance adventurers to investigate the smoking ruins of his former home.
